title: Evidence dialog
responsibility: Displays titled evidence or text in a native modal dialog with optional footer content.

inputs.name: Modal.open
inputs.description: Optional open state, defaulting to false. Used only when isOpen is null or undefined.

inputs.name: Modal.isOpen
inputs.description: Optional open-state alias that takes precedence over open, including when false.

inputs.name: Modal.title
inputs.description: Optional dialog heading, defaulting to an empty string.

inputs.name: Modal.variant
inputs.description: Optional presentation, defaulting to image. Text adds text styling; lightbox fills the viewport.

inputs.name: Modal.onClose
inputs.description: Optional close request callback for the close button, backdrop and native cancel event. Called alongside onclose when both are supplied; the parent owns open state.

inputs.name: Modal.onclose
inputs.description: Optional alternate close request callback, invoked after onClose for the same close actions. It does not replace onClose.

inputs.name: Modal.children
inputs.description: Optional dialog body content; omitted content renders nothing.

inputs.name: Modal.footer
inputs.description: Optional footer content. The footer is rendered only when this snippet is supplied.

outputs.name: Modal
outputs.description: A native dialog when isOpen, or otherwise open, is true. It shows the title, child content and optional footer in the selected image, text or lightbox presentation. Close-button and backdrop actions invoke both supplied close callbacks; Escape also invokes them through the cancel event. The parent owns the open state.
